mapper.select: SELECT c.CONCERT_ID AS ID, c.TITLE, c.DESCRIPTION, c.ARTIST_NAME, c.GENRE, NVL(s.PERFORMANCE_DATE, 'TBD') AS PERFORMANCE_DATE, TO_CHAR(c.BOOKING_OPEN_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS BOOKING_DATE, v.NAME AS LOCATION FROM CONCERT c JOIN VENUE v ON c.VENUE_ID = v.VENUE_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CONCERT_ID, CASE WHEN TRUNC(MIN(START_TIME)) = TRUNC(MAX(START_TIME)) THEN TO_CHAR(MIN(START_TIME), 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') ELSE TO_CHAR(MIN(START_TIME), 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR(MAX(START_TIME), 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') END AS PERFORMANCE_DATE FROM CONCERT_SESSION GROUP BY CONCERT_ID ) s ON c.CONCERT_ID = s.CONCERT_ID WHERE c.CONCERT_ID = #{concertId}
